$comment: Which of a use-case node's settings a run sends its route, on BOTH engines: the server's (backend/src/services/workflow-engine/__tests__/use-case-sent-settings.test.ts, freshRunInputs) and the editor's (frontend/src/__tests__/use-case-sent-settings.test.ts, the executor's request body without the caller's userId) are each held to the bodies here, key order included. The rule (usecaseSentSettings): an unset setting is not sent; a null only where the type's body takes one (a None); an empty string only where the body takes one (free text), any other empty value left out so the route takes its default; anything else as the node holds it. Each case is a node of `type` holding `data`, with one recording wired. Written by hand; a case is added, an existing expectation is changed only by a ruled decision.

cases.name: Tighten Episode: an empty instruction and style guide are sent as empty
Tighten Episode: a None framing is sent; a null its body does not take is not
Chapters: its defaults, the empty instruction and style guide included
Trailer: a null review is not sent; an empty instruction is
Clip Pack: a None framing is sent, a null captions is not, an empty style guide is
Tighten Episode: an empty choice (captionStyle, planTier) is not sent; the route takes its default instead of refusing the run
Clip Pack: an empty caption style and tier are not sent; an empty instruction is
